questions.stem: What is the purpose of a scale drawing?

options.text: To represent real objects at their actual size.
To represent real objects in a smaller, proportional size.
To enlarge real objects on paper.

questions.explanation: Scale drawings are used to represent real objects in a smaller, proportional size, making it easier to visualize and work with large objects on paper.

distractorRationale.a: This option is incorrect because scale drawings reduce the size proportionally.
distractorRationale.c: Scale drawings do not enlarge objects; they reduce them proportionally.
distractorRationale.d: While artistic designs can use scale, the primary purpose of scale drawings is representation.

questions.stem: A building is 50 meters tall. On a scale drawing, it is represented as 5 cm tall. What is the scale of the drawing?
questions.explanation: The scale is determined by dividing the real height by the drawing height: \( \frac{50}{5} = 10 \). Thus, the scale is 1 cm : 10 m.

distractorRationale.a: This option results from incorrectly dividing the real height by the drawing height.
distractorRationale.c: This option results from miscalculating the scale factor.
distractorRationale.d: This option results from misunderstanding the relationship between real and drawing sizes.
